commands.name: claude-help
commands.stdout:
usage: task-runtime {status,start,checkpoint,finish,doctor} ...

Default lifecycle:
  status      Show health and one exact recommended action
  start       Claim or resume dependency-ready work
  checkpoint  Save interrupted work and release its claim
  finish      Run declared gates, record proof, and close work
  doctor      Diagnose independent framework health dimensions

Run `task-runtime advanced --help` for compatibility, migration, planning, evidence, sync, and maintenance commands.
